title: Design an invariance and regularisation study
promptMarkdown: A team classifies handwritten digits and also predicts the location of a marked point in each image. They rotate every image by 180°, keep both labels unchanged, create ten augmented copies before random row splitting, standardise all splits together, and choose dropout,λ and early-stopping epoch by the best of80 test runs. Give a corrected study design for both tasks. Specify which labels may need transformation, the split unit, preprocessing, a small reproducible ablation and selection budget, baseline, seed policy, final evaluation and a concrete failure case. Explain why ten crops are not ten independent originals.
hintLadder: Separate invariant classification labels from equivariant coordinates.
Trace each descendant back to its original source.
Every architecture/penalty/dropout/checkpoint choice belongs inside selection.
